name: DeckView
author: ernes
description: Zooms out deck-like views for Slay the Spire 2 so the whole deck is visible at a glance. Shrinks the deck view, draw/discard/exhaust piles, card library, and deck card-select screens; hovering a card pops it back to full size. Leaves the combat hand, inspect popup, and reward/shop screens at normal size. Toggle on screen with the Mini-cards checkbox or press T; the choice persists across runs. Changes visibility and UI layout only—it does not change cards, routes, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay. (The whole-act map view that older DeckView builds bundled is now the separate FlatMap mod.) Targets Slay the Spire 2 v0.109.0.
